title: Baila Conmigo
style: Rumba with a buoyant clave groove and hand percussion driving a warm mid-tempo sway; verse stays intimate with palm-muted guitar and soft congas, pre-chorus opens with claps and rising coro vocals, chorus blooms with brass hits and call-and-response chants. Lead vocal stays close and breathy in verses, doubled and lifted on hooks, with airy ad-libs and delay throws. Maraca flicks, reversed percussion swells, and a short drum fill before each chorus. Bright, percussive, and sunlit in the mix., rumba, uplifting
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I saw you by the door
And my heart said more
Your name in my mouth
Feels like warm rain now

You move like a spark
Right through the dark
I keep my cool, but you know
I’m leaning close

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t let this night pass by
I can’t keep it inside
If you take my hand
I’ll show you where I stand

[Chorus]
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Hold me close tonight
And let it feel so right
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Say my name one time
And I’ll stay by your side

[Verse 2]
You laugh and the room
Turns sweet perfume
Your eyes pull me in
Like the tide comes again

I came here to dance
But I want a chance
To take you home in my soul
And never let go

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t let this night pass by
I can’t keep it inside
If you take my hand
I’ll show you where I stand

[Chorus]
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Hold me close tonight
And let it feel so right
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Say my name one time
And I’ll stay by your side

[Bridge]
If the moon falls down
I’ll still be around
If the crowd moves on
I’ll keep holding on

Take the last slow turn
Let the whole room burn
Baby, I’m right here
And I’m not going nowhere

[Chorus]
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Hold me close tonight
And let it feel so right
I want to be with you
I want to be with you
Say my name one time
And I’ll stay by your side
